title: School Nutrition Services Meal Account Terms for Refund Checks, Sibling Transfers and Purchase Corrections
content:
The following terms of the School Nutrition Services Meal Account apply to every meal status.

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Smallest balance refunded by district check; smaller balances can only be transferred to a sibling or are held (the refund minimum) | 5.00 USD |
| Calendar days after an approved refund request within which the check is mailed | 21 |
| Months after inactivation after which an unclaimed positive balance with no sibling account is applied to the district's student meal assistance fund | 12 |
| A positive balance may be moved to another student's meal account in the same household | yes |
| Calendar days after a purchase within which the household may dispute it, the purchase date being day 0 | 30 |
| A cashier may void a purchase only on the day it was rung up | yes |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A refund approved on a given day is mailed no later than the 21st calendar day after it. A purchase rung up on a given day (day 0) may be disputed through day 30. A balance of 4.15 is below the 5.00 refund minimum.
